decisions.statement: The account whose seven-day window resets soonest is picked.
A tie on the hours until the seven-day reset falls to the lower seven-day share.
A tie on the seven-day share falls to the lower five-hour share.
A tie on both shares falls to the account slug ascending.
An account is eligible where both its shares sit below 100.
An account the exclude set names is dropped before the ranking.
An account no measurement covers is ranked as having spent nothing.
An account no measurement covers is ranked by the hours an unknown reset answers.
A fleet with no eligible account is answered as no pick.
The hours until a seven-day reset are answered by a function handed in.
A pool summary counts the accounts that are eligible.
A pool summary has the count of the whole fleet.
A maxed account is free again at the later of the resets blocking that account.
A blocking window naming no reset leaves an account's return unknown.
An eligibility breakdown names each account beside its reasons.
A pick answers with the candidate the caller handed in rather than with a copy.
The moment a pick is made at reaches this code as a number.
A caller ranks only the accounts that caller hands in.
A candidate has the account slug the measurements are keyed by.
Nothing here reads a file.
Nothing here reads the clock.
Nothing here fetches the accounts a ranking reads.
Eligibility never reads `subscriptionDisabled`.
Eligibility never reads `renewalTerminal`.
Eligibility never reads `fiveHourAtLimitUntil`.
Eligibility never reads `accessTokenExpiresAt`.
An account whose subscription is withdrawn is picked as any other account is.
An account that can no longer renew itself is picked as any other account is.
The hours answered for an unknown seven-day reset sit below a freshly opened window's hours.
An account no measurement covers outranks an account whose window just reset.
An account whose seven-day reset has passed is ranked as an account with no known reset.
A seven-day reset that will not parse is ranked as a reset nothing is known about.
The ordering here is spelled a second time in `model-account-measuring`.
The account types this module reads sit under the gateway rather than under the accounts.

definition: which account of a fleet a call is made on next
